subject.title: Feature Request: cron.defaults.delivery config for default delivery target

question: Should OpenClaw add a persistent core default recipient for primary cron announce delivery, and should that default be copied into a job when it is created or resolved dynamically when the job runs?
rationale: The choice determines whether config edits can silently retarget existing scheduled output and therefore sets the durable privacy, upgrade, and operator contract.

options.title: Creation-time defaulting
options.body: Use `cron.defaults.delivery` only to fill omitted delivery at job creation, persist the resolved route on the job, and keep later config changes from retargeting existing jobs.

options.title: Runtime inheritance
options.body: Resolve omitted primary delivery from current config at every run, accepting that a later config change intentionally retargets existing jobs.

options.title: Keep explicit-only routing
options.body: Retain per-job delivery and captured-route behavior without adding a global primary recipient default.

recommendation.title: Creation-time defaulting
recommendation.body: Use `cron.defaults.delivery` only to fill omitted delivery at job creation, persist the resolved route on the job, and keep later config changes from retargeting existing jobs.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged work owns the central initial-delivery invariant that the chosen policy would extend.
